A few determined traders hang on, although their customers are mostly [[Centaur]]s from the plains. }} The [[Gate of Desolation (outpost)|Gate of Desolation]] is the [[outpost]] that connects [[Kourna]] to [[the Desolation]]. It is the last bastion of civilization against the sulfurous wasteland. == Getting there == The [[primary quest]] [[Crossing the Desolation]] leads here for the next [[mission]] of the [[Nightfall campaign]]. This [[mission outpost]] is located on the northwestern end of [[Turai's Procession]]. ==Exits == * [[The Sulfurous Wastes]] (northwest) * [[Turai's Procession]] (southeast) == NPCs == === Allies === ==== Services ==== * {{x}} 20 [[Wandering Scribe]]s (3 [[collector]]s for 1, 3, and 5 [[Ancient Artifact]]s) * {{x}} 20 [[Sahnbur]] ([[merchant]]) * {{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) ===== Henchmen ===== : ''(all level 20)'' * {{w}} [[Devona]] (Fighter) * {{r}} [[Aidan]] (Archer) * {{mo}} [[Kihm]] (Healer) * {{mo}} [[Mhenlo]] (Healer) * {{n}} [[Eve]] (Blood) * {{me}} [[Odurra]] (Illusion) * {{e}} [[Cynn]] (Fire) * {{e}} [[Herta]] (Earth) * {{p}} [[Sogolon]] (Motivation) * {{d}} [[Gehraz]] (Holy) ==== Other allies ==== * {{x}} 20 [[Laph Longmane]] (mission access) * {{x}} 15 [[Nermak]] (mission briefing) * {{x}} 20 [[Ascension Pilgrim]] * {{x}} 20 [[Dynastic Spirit]] == Notes == * The [[world map]] actually marks this location with the icon for an outpost upon initial arrival. It changes into the icon for a mission outpost only upon completion of the quest that precedes the [[Gate of Desolation|Gate of Desolation mission]], which is [[Crossing the Desolation]]. == Trivia == * The map that comes with the Guild Wars Nightfall: Collector's Edition box calls this outpost Gates of Desolation, making the definition grammatically incorrect. Additionally, this outpost was called Gates of Desolation in-game until an update rectified it to its current name. {{Towns and outposts in the Desolation}}
